title: School ERP Software Cost in India
seoTitle: School ERP Software Cost in India (2026 Guide)
seoDescription: What a custom school or college ERP costs in India: admissions, fees, attendance, exams, parent app. Cost bands, timelines, running costs and drivers.
summary: A custom school ERP in India typically costs ₹5 lakh to ₹12 lakh for one school covering admissions, fees, attendance and exams, ₹12 lakh to ₹30 lakh for a group of schools or a college with a parent and student app, and more for universities with complex academic rules.

costBands.includes: Admissions, fees with online payment, attendance, timetable, exams and report cards
Multiple campuses, parent and student app, transport, library, dashboards
Credit systems, electives, research, hostels, accreditation reporting

dataPoints.label: Biggest cost drivers
dataPoints.value: Exam and grading rules, number of campuses, parent app, payment and SMS/WhatsApp integrations

dataPoints.label: Peak load
dataPoints.value: Admissions and results days need capacity planning

dataPoints.label: Data
dataPoints.value: Student data is personal data of minors; strict access control and parental consent handling

dataPoints.label: Common add-on
dataPoints.value: AI assistant for admission queries on website and WhatsApp

body:
## What moves the price

- Fee structures with concessions, instalments and late fees.
- Exam patterns and report card formats per board.
- Parent communication: app, WhatsApp, SMS.
- Migration of existing student records.

See [software for schools, colleges and training institutes](/blog/software-for-schools-colleges-and-training-institutes) and [AI chatbots for universities](/blog/ai-chatbots-for-universities-and-colleges-admissions-queries-and-student-support).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Is a school ERP better as SaaS?
faqs.a: For standard needs, SaaS is quicker and cheaper. Custom suits groups with specific processes or integration needs.

faqs.q: Can parents pay fees by UPI?
faqs.a: Yes, through a payment gateway such as Razorpay, with automatic receipts and reconciliation.
